Gallery Walk QR Codes

Turn a list of student work links into a printable set of QR codes for a gallery walk — nothing leaves your browser

Student work entries
Name / titleLink or text

Example: Ava R.  docs.google.com/document/d/abc123
Also works with plain commas: Marco T., drive.google.com/drive/folders/xyz

A link missing "https://" (like "docs.google.com/...") gets it added automatically. Anything that doesn't look like a link or address is encoded as plain text as-is — handy for pointing at instructions instead of a URL.
Print layout
The reference sheet is just your own lookup list (name → link) — there's nothing secret on it, unlike an answer key, so it's fine to keep with the QR pages if that's handy.
